svg.text: Low-fidelity flow: one verse from the pulpit to the screen
Each frame is the whole console. The dark region is where the operator looks at that moment.
Typed cards are always high confidence.
The chip goes hollow. Paraphrase detection
VideoPsalm did not respond. Bridge restarted.
The bridge times out after 5 s, restarts,
and says so in the status bar.
